Print the current date and time using the datetime module.

Supplied answer
from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta
now = datetime.now()
print("Now :", now)
print("Formatted:", now.strftime("%d-%m-%Y %H:%M:%S"))
print("Today :", date.today())
print("Tomorrow :", date.today() + timedelta(days=1))
Note: strftime() turns a date into text; strptime() turns text into a date.
